about: Ratita Preview Center data (see PREVIEW.md). Builders edit this file: 'items' feed the posters + the Scheduled Additions board, 'previews' feed the Time Jumper. Live GitHub issue labels override 'stage' when the arcade is online, except that an item marked 'shipped' here stays shipped (issues are sometimes left open after release). Keep items newest first.

items.name: Grocery Tycoon Patch: Packing Help + Drive the Truck
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon free patch for Super Shop Online Pass (David's idea #52): easy packing with floor arrows, glowing shelves and a checklist that says which aisle or rack, a Stop packing button so staff take over, a $3,000 welcome bonus for new players (and a one-time gift for existing saves), and YOU drive the Ship Center truck (2-day shipping) and the Grok Van (same-day) on real roads to new spots past Maple Lane: Cedar Court and Riverside Apartments. GPS, crashes, repair bills and Torty's Tow.

items.name: Grok Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab (live)
items.what: Grok Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab is open! A spooky Halloween exploration game on the brand-new Shadowlight engine: sneak down abandoned Old Town Street, find the hidden Ratita Industries lab and explore its 2 floors and 11 underground levels by flashlight (the Goo Factory, the Robot Workshop, the brick sewer and the Goo Core), film anomalies to go viral and uncover what Luna, Pi-rat and Snowie's great-great-great-grandparents really did. Play it in ADVENTURE, plus bonus game #45 Goo Cam!

items.name: Super Shop Online Pass (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon: your store goes ONLINE! An Online Store desk takes orders 3 ways: in-store pickup, same-day delivery (a shopper picks the items in your store, then a Grok Van drives them to a house on Maple Lane) and shipping in 2 days from the brand-new walk-in Shopsville Ship Center, packed with racks, a packing line, a conveyor, a truck dock and workers, run by Martina "Torty". Plus your own phone: check orders, call people to set things up, hold meetings, buy upgrades and more stock. Keep your star rating up! Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty order too. 75 tickets. Live now in Grok Grocery Tycoon! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Super Sky High Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours MEGA DLC: fly SUPER SKY HIGH (the ceiling goes from 175 m to 320 m) to three floating sky areas that change how you fly: Frostbite Isle (snowfall, gusts and ice that builds up on your wings), Ember Isle (a live volcano with thermal updrafts, ash haze and lava bombs) and the Fly High Arena, where you battle high-tech planes and copters in foam-bubble dogfights (free-for-all, or team up with Candy; Easy, Normal or Ace). Plus the Sky Highway boost rings, 6 Sky Gems and 6 new badges. 175 tickets. Live now in Grok Snowie Sky Tours! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Bigger Hall + Bonus Zone East Wing (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: the Hall of Records got cramped again, so it grows a GRAND GALLERY behind the Records Annex (the exhibits squeezed into the aisles move in, plus room for 14 more games). The Bonus Zone breaks through its east wall into a whole new EAST WING, so every bonus cabinet is full size again with room for 56. And meet GRANDMA MRS, Gary's great-great-grandmother and the new head attendant of the Bonus Zone: very nice, sometimes TOO nice (cookies!), easily sidetracked into drama, and her phone is always broken. Fix it for tickets. Live now in Grok Arcade! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Bob's Account Desk: Live Sync (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: LIVE SYNC comes to Bob's Account Desk! Turn it on and Bob gives you a 6-digit ID. Type it on your other device and tap YES on a linked one (with a match code, so nobody sneaks in). Up to 3 devices, see them all and unlink any. Tickets, prizes, DLC and every Grok game's progress sync both ways by themselves: the newest change wins, an empty save never wipes progress, and Bob keeps a backup before every update (Undo last sync). Share with friends lets a friend peek at your stats with your ID and compare (look, don't touch). Works offline and catches up later. Live now at Bob's desk! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Pickleball Park (live)
items.what: Grok Pickleball Park is open! A giant cartoon 3D sports park built around real pickleball (two-bounce rule, the kitchen, side-out scoring): singles or doubles, easy swipe/tap shots, the 10-rung Park Ladder and 4 tournaments, the Stadium Court with Umpire Pi-rat, the Night Lights Court, Torty's Pro Shop, the Clubhouse, the Snack Shack and Luna's Training Center. Play it in SPORTS, plus bonus game #44 Target Drill!

items.name: Bob's Account Desk (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: Bob's Account Desk is open by the GROK ARCADE wall! Bob, Lili's long, chatty, nice-but-pushy big brother, gives you a 6-digit account ID + name. TRANSFER SAVE moves your whole Grok save (Arcade tickets, prizes, badges, DLC and every Grok game) to another device with a code, QR, link or file; LOAD SAVE backs up first and RESTORE BACKUP undoes it. Live Sync (3 devices, friends) comes later: it needs a save server. (Premium Platinum Plus still doesn't exist.)

items.name: Crash & Repair Patch (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours patch: the tow-drone now ALWAYS comes (crash anywhere, plus a TOW button), crashes dent your aircraft and cost coins, fares and passenger stars, a walk-in Repair Hangar packed with detail (paint booth, welding sparks, crane hoist, parts racks, Mechanic Brie and crew, pet cameos and Torty's Tortuga Tech crash-test lab), 7 aircraft to unlock (copters, biplane, seaplane, cargo, jet) with clear cockpit views and a copter dashboard, and a tidier world with runways, a farm, Rainbow Falls, a sea dock and a camp. Live now in Grok Snowie Sky Tours!

items.name: Grok Grocery Tycoon (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon: run a store in the cartoon 3D town of Shopsville! Climb from courtesy clerk to owner in Career Mode or build an empire of 11 store types as the boss, walk into every store and all 9 rival shops, and run deliveries from your own distribution center. Play it in Hubs & Worlds, plus bonus game #43 Cart Dash!

items.name: Spookster Mega Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Pumpkin Hollow MEGA DLC: green sludge is bubbling out of a fenced-off site, and under it is THE GLOOMWORKS, a hidden underground facility full of mad scientists and spooky tests. Investigate who built it and why (and who keeps opening the sludge valves!), unlock 6 new skins, and play Spooky Mode 2.0 (BOO, HAUNT, VANISH, FLICKER + the Night Shift challenge, based on Grok Spooks' Spook 'Em). Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty visit. 175 tickets in the DLC Machine. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Ruffsources HQ (live)
items.what: Grok Ruffsources HQ: a walk-in HR office run by dogs. Sort the mail, file paperwork, interview new hires, find 26 golden bones and solve the mystery of Candy's missing squeaky toy. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Grok Snowie Sky Tours (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours: fly Snowie's tour copter over a big open world. Tour stops, pet rescues, ring courses, and 9 packed walk-in buildings plus 14 cottages full of mini-games and chores. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Merry Events Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok North Pole Village: the North Pole Event Center with live events on the real santaupdate.com calendar: the Annual Reindeer Games, the Halloween Party, the Thanksgiving Day Elf Parade and the Christmas Day Party. 75 tickets in the DLC Machine.

items.name: Merry Tracking Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok North Pole Village: the Sleigh Port opens next to Flight Command HQ. Fly to all 5 walk-in Regional Tracking Centers, meet the Elf Supervisors and help set up. Fully online on Dec 24-25 with live Santa tracking. 75 tickets in the DLC Machine.

items.name: Grok Pumpkin Hollow (live)
items.what: Grok Pumpkin Hollow: a moonlit Halloween town with the Ghost Train, the Scream-o-Vision Picture House, the Bat Caves and Boo Row (10 spooky walk-in shops, each with an activity). Solve Who swiped the Moon Lantern? Co-op for 3. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Grok North Pole Village (live)
items.what: Grok North Pole Village: a snowy Christmas village with Santa, the North Pole Express, Operations Row (the Wrapping Department + 20 departments with activities), 80 real elves from santaupdate.com at their jobs and Wish Lists checked twice. Co-op for 3. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Fiesta Kits (live)
items.what: Grok FC: 4 festive teams with real 3D sombreros, party hats and flower crowns, the rainbow Piñata Ball and 3D fireworks + confetti on fiesta goals.

items.name: Cabinet animation fix (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: the 6 Bonus Zone cabinets with blank screens (Ghost Lantern '83, Crumb Patrol, Bone Dig, Sparkle Car Wash, Patty Panic, Shell Drop) now have their own animated attract screens.

items.name: Grok Torty Town (live)
items.what: Grok Torty Town: Torty's hometown, a sunny desert oasis where everything moves at turtle pace. 25+ walk-in buildings, Tortuga Tech Inc., the Sunstone mystery, 6 mini-games, co-op for 3. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Ratita Stadium Night (live)
items.what: Grok Sports Command: the night-lights Ratita Stadium with Ice Hockey, Glow Mini-Golf, Cheese Curling, the Ratita Mascot Race and the Ratita Cup tournament (4 cheese cups to win).

items.name: Grok Lost Relics (live)
items.what: A cartoon 3D relic-hunting adventure: whip-swing over croc rivers, sneak past the Relic Patrol (they think YOU'RE the thief), dodge boulders, darts and spike floors, solve temple puzzles and beat Professor Vintage's 5 crazy machines across the jungle, crystal caves, a clockwork subway, a pyramid and a sky fortress. Fill your Relic Museum, outfits, gear and co-op for 3.

items.name: Ratita Super Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Pup Town: Ratita Row opens east of Paw Park! 5 enterable buildings + the Test Yard, The Missing Prototype mystery with Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie and Torty, 4 new mini-games, a Cheese Coin gadget store and 12 Golden Gears.

items.name: Super Grid Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Grid: Sky Islands, Candy Kingdom and Volcano Run, 4 new cars, boost pads + items, and the Super Grid Hub you can drive around (Garage, Pit Stop Cafe, stunt park, Torty, 12 Golden Lug Nuts).

items.name: Grok Eatsville Tycoon (live)
items.what: A cartoon 3D restaurant tycoon in Eatsville: work up from Mega Munch trainee or open your own diner, cook and serve, run deliveries, decorate your house, beat Mega Munch and Pizza Palooza, keep it spotless for Inspector Grumbleton and fix the Ratita gadgets. Explore mode, Golden Spatulas, co-op for 3.

items.name: Grok Rides Remastered (live)
items.what: Grok Rides rebuilt on the Tempest engine: a bigger map with a beach town and mountain road, lived-in walk-in interiors, smarter traffic, rain and puddles, 31 rides incl. helicopter, seaplane, hovercraft, ice cream truck, fire truck, tow truck, hot air balloon and the Ratita hover-car, plus bonus #35 Sparkle Car Wash and 3 prizes. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Super Kart Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Kart Party Expansion: 4 new racers (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy), Ratita Labs Raceway + Torty's Garden Grand Prix in the new Ratita Cup, staff ghosts with medals, and the 10-rung Ratita Challenge Ladder.

items.name: Fiesta Fits (live)
items.what: Grok Land Party Mini Pack: 6 new skins (Ratita Mascot, Party-Hat Gus, Disco Astronaut and more), 6 hats, 6 trails, 4 dance emotes, a confetti cannon and a bouncy party horn.

items.name: Pi-rat the Pirate Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Ratita Rescue MEGA: sail the Salty Cheddar with Captain Eye Patch and Grumbles to 5 islands (puzzles, hazards, 5 bosses, treasure) plus the Dresser Shop. 175 tickets in the DLC Machine. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Good Life Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Life Mini Pack: the Ratita Industries Gadget Shop with 8 working gadgets (Fix-It Hammer, RatPhone 5 drone delivery, Tablet remote work, Hover-Board, Bubble Shield and more) plus 5 Ratita outfits.

items.name: Midnight Express (live)
items.what: Grok Detective Expansion: who stole the Golden Cheese? 5 walk-in train cars, 6 suspects with alibis, fingerprint dusting, a clue corkboard, Disguise mode, co-op clue sharing and a big reveal.

items.name: Grok Pup Town (live)
items.what: Grok Pup Town: Candy's hometown, a cozy 3D dog town hub in HUBS & WORLDS, with bonus #34 Bone Dig and 3 Pup Town prizes. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Ratita Preview Center (live)
items.what: Lili's Preview Center behind the Food Court: posters, this board, the Time Jumper and bonus game #32 Chrono Courier.

items.name: Ratita HQ (live)
items.what: Grok Ratita Industries HQ: a 3D hub world in the new HUBS & WORLDS gallery section, bonus #33 Crumb Patrol and 3 HQ prizes.

items.name: Records Annex (live)
items.what: The Hall of Game Records doubled: Uncle Barnaby, the Exhibit of the Week, a reading nook, a photo booth and seats.

items.name: Pickle Smash Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Pickleball: Smash Mode with 6 Smasher supers, 3 new venues (Lava Island, Moon Base, Candy Stadium) and 3 new paddles.

items.name: Ratita Industries Super Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Spooks: Spook 'Em mode in Willowmere Mansion as Wisp the ghost, plus 2 new Ratita Industries lab floors with 2 new bosses.

items.name: Super Thunder Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Disaster Zone MEGA: 3 new disasters (Acid Storm, Dragon Attack, Dino Destruction), 3 new maps and the new Weather Hunter mode.

items.name: Stuck camera fix (live)
items.what: Grok Sports Command: when a match ends you get the results screen and PLAZA takes you back with the normal camera. No more stuck sky camera.

previews.name: Grocery Tycoon Patch: Packing Help + Drive the Truck
previews.notes: FREE patch for Super Shop Online Pass (#52/#51). Packing guidance: floor arrows, glowing shelves, a checklist with aisle/rack + bay, a clear pack station. NEW Stop packing button hands the order to staff (slower, 10% less pay). New players start with +$3,000 (existing saves get a one-time $3,000 gift). DRIVE the Ship Center truck (2-day) and the Grok Van (same-day): GPS route, gas/brake, crashes = damage + repair bill + late parcels, Torty's Tow back to the dock. New delivery spots past Maple Lane: Cedar Road, Cedar Court and Riverside Apartments, plus a gas station, sports field and Cedar Park. Snowie and Pi-rat ride along. Preview uses its own sandbox save.

previewsHelp: Playable work-in-progress snapshots for the Time Jumper. Only add one when it REALLY works. Make it with: node tools/make-preview.js <source-dir> <id> (see PREVIEW.md). Fields: id, game, issue, name, url (previews/<id>/ on this site), playable:true, built (date), notes.

archive.name: Grok Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab
archive.label: Final Beta (Time Jumper)
archive.notes: NEW spooky Halloween game on the new Shadowlight engine. Detail pass v2: every room on every level is packed with themed props, wall posters/signs/vents/pipes and abandoned-lab mess. B2 is a real Goo Factory (vats, tanks, jar conveyor, control panels), B6 a Robot Workshop (broken robots, robot arms, tool walls, blueprints), B7 a brick sewer with a water channel and arches, a smaller Goo Core on B11, doorways between rooms, and a busier Old Town + Bev's Diner. Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Torty and Candy are all there. Preview uses its own sandbox save.

archive.name: Super Shop Online Pass
archive.label: Final Beta (Time Jumper)
archive.notes: Detail pass: busy Online Orders zone (pickup line with stanchions, full cubbies, bag rack, parked carts, scanner charging dock, restocker + 2nd clerk), Ship Center with varied labelled stock, totes, wrapped pallets, rack barcodes, aisle signs, floor markings, pallet jacks and more workers, and a lively Maple Lane (cars, fences, porch packages, kids and neighbours). 3 order types: in-store pickup, same-day Grok Van delivery, 2-day shipping. Phone: orders, calls, meetings, upgrades, buy stock. DLC is unlocked in the preview; add ?locked=1 to see it locked.

archive.name: Super Sky High Expansion
archive.label: Final Beta (Time Jumper)
archive.notes: Pass 3: correct zone names on Ember Isle / Arena / lobby, fuller Ember Isle terrace (scorched trees, rocks, lava-rock walls, benches, tourists), volcano damage scaled by speed (slow bump = small scrape, hard hit = crash + tow). Plus pass 2: volcano, Lava Lab, Frostbite village + Cocoa Lodge, Fly High Arena, 3 new aircraft, pet cameos.

archive.name: Bigger Hall + Bonus Zone East Wing
archive.label: Final Beta (Time Jumper)
archive.notes: Detail pass: East Wing has the Prize Peek island (Luna on top), Easy + Tricky claws, the Ticket Muncher 9000, a lounge, Grandma's snack cart, a light-up floor path and visitors playing. Grandma Mrs' desk has tea, cookies, a radio, family photos, a rocking chair and Candy napping. The Grand Gallery (behind the Annex) has chandeliers, wall art, the Golden Cartridge, visitors and Torty on a visit. Preview uses its own sandbox save.

archive.name: Bob's Account Desk: Live Sync

Preview uses the test server and this preview's own sandbox save; your real save is never touched.

Its own game in the Time Jumper (not Grok Pickleball).

Live Sync: coming soon. Preview: exports read your real save (read only); loads stay in this preview's sandbox.

archiveHelp: Save Booth (Save Vault in the Preview Center): the LAST Time Jumper preview of every game that shipped, kept playable forever at archive/<id>-beta/ with its own grokBeta.<id>. save. Made with: node tools/make-preview.js --archive <id> (never delete previews). Each entry also shows in that game's Hall of Records Old Versions as 'Final Beta (Time Jumper)'.
